request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Anvilkin Porter".

Creative brief
Name: Anvilkin Porter
Collection: Ashforge Remnants. Abandoned forge creatures and half-living constructs powered by coals, slag, chains, soot, and unstable furnace heat.
Core concept: A heavy support construct that creates shockwaves by dropping its carried anvil.
Body and silhouette: Squat stone-and-iron humanoid carrying a broad anvil above one shoulder.
Signature features: Anvil-shaped upper silhouette, coal-filled eye sockets, and blocky gauntlets.
Palette and materials: Iron gray, basalt black, rust brown, and ember orange.
Movement personality: Labored, stubborn, and dangerously strong.
Attack concept: Lifts the anvil higher before slamming it down, sending two expanding semicircles of ground sparks with a gap behind it.
Directional details: The anvil is always carried over the right shoulder.
Avoid: Blacksmith human, giant boss scale, photorealistic metal shading.
